agentCenter.title: Third-party Agents
agentCenter.description: Connect Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and other Agents to your chats. Once connected and checked, they show up when you start a chat or add a group member.

rail.reorderHint: Drag to reorder, or press Alt+Up / Alt+Down. This is the order in the chat and group pickers.

notInstalled.status_install: Not installed. You can install it here.
notInstalled.status_docs: Not installed. Follow the official install guide.

installFailed.status: Install failed. See the log below.

versionLow.status: This version is too old. Update it to continue.

adapterMissing.status: The ACP adapter is missing. You can install it here.

available.status: Installed. Not connected to chats yet.

needsRecheck.statusChanged: Settings changed. Check again to use them.

signedOut.status: Signed out. New turns fail until you sign in.

connectFailed.status: Connection failed. See the check results.

connection.title: Connection
connection.desc: How {{name}} reaches its models. A change is checked before it replaces the saved connection.
connection.draftNote: You changed the connection. It is checked first; the saved connection keeps working until the check passes.

modeDesc.nativeLogin: Use the account the Agent itself is signed in with.
modeDesc.provider: Use an API key from Model providers and bill that.
modeDesc.kunGateway: Route through the local gateway and limit which accounts it may use.

delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.body: Its launch settings are removed from this computer. Chats that already used it keep their history.

diagnostics.title: Check results
diagnostics.empty: Run a check to see the command, sign-in and handshake results here.
diagnostics.trialHint: Want proof a real chat works? A trial sends one real request and may use quota.

launch.title: Launch
launch.desc: How Kun starts {{name}}. Leave a field empty to use what was detected. Changes need a re-check.
launch.managedByExtension: The extension {{name}} manages this Agent's command and arguments, so they cannot be edited here.
launch.envDesc: Passed to the Agent when Kun starts it. Sensitive values go to the system credential store; this file only keeps a reference.
launch.previewDesc: This is how Kun starts {{name}} after you save. Sensitive values are never shown.
launch.noOverrides: {{name}} runs inside Kun through its SDK, so extra arguments and environment variables are not passed to it. Set its network and command path here; configure the rest in {{name}} itself.

models.title: Available models
models.customLabel: Not listed? Use a model ID directly

signedOut.title: {{name}} is signed out
signedOut.body: New turns fail until you sign in again. Kun prefills {{command}} in a terminal tab for you to review and run, then re-checks when it closes.

needsRecheck.title: {{name}} needs a re-check
needsRecheck.body: Settings changed or the runtime restarted. Check again so new turns use the current settings.

connectFailed.title: Could not connect to {{name}}
connectFailed.body: The check results below show the step that failed. Fix it, then check again.

versionLow.title: {{name}} is too old
versionLow.body: Update it from the Version tab to keep using it.

setup.title: Connect {{name}}
setup.subtitle: Three steps. Afterwards {{name}} shows up when you start a chat or add a group member.
setup.missing: Kun could not find the command. Check the path, or install it yourself.
setup.missingInstall: Install it on this computer. Kun detects it again when the install ends.
setup.pathLink: Not this one? Set the command path
setup.pathLinkMissing: Already installed? Set the command path
setup.connectionDesc: How {{name}} reaches its models. You can change this later under Connection.
setup.checkDesc: Checks the command, sign-in and protocol handshake. It sends no prompt and uses no quota.
setup.checkHint: You can also use the switch at the top right.

addDialog.intro: Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and the other built-in Agents are already in the list. Pick one there to connect it. Add an Agent that is not in the list here.

kind_derive.title: Based on a built-in Agent
kind_derive.desc: Run a built-in engine with another command, arguments or environment, for example a company fork of OpenCode, or a second account for the same Agent.

kind_acp.title: Any ACP Agent
kind_acp.desc: Enter a command that speaks the Agent Client Protocol. Kun talks to it through the generic adapter.

kind_import.title: Import a configuration file
kind_import.desc: Import a .json Agent definition exported from Kun. Sensitive values have to be entered again on this computer.

addDialog.importHint: Choose the .json file to read. The form below is filled from it and still needs a test before it can be added.
addDialog.name: Name
addDialog.commandHint: An executable name or a full path.
addDialog.commandHintBase: Leave empty to use the built-in engine's command.
addDialog.testFirst: Test before adding: it checks that the command starts and completes the handshake. It sends no prompt.
addDialog.failureHint: If the test fails you can still add it and troubleshoot from its page.

login.title: Sign-in
login.desc: {{name}} uses its own account. If it is not signed in yet, or you want another account, sign in once in a terminal; Kun detects it again when the terminal closes.
